stage: Explicit evaluation-author acceptance for synthetic Boolean probes only
observations: Synthetic probe contexts explicitly provide planning state, per-action user-request facts, and whether the hypothetical action is selected. No real user request, secret detector, service call, or production observation is inferred.
reason: Raw predicted quotes, atoms, modality, conditions and exceptions were checked against pinned source fragments and independent model references. Only the7prohibitions are accepted as finite structural models for a controlled experiment.
limitations: This review is not independent human adjudication.
Accepted structural representation does not establish real-world sensors or runtime integration.
Numeric typography and active-voice recognition remain ungrounded and are not accepted.
